title: Aurobindo Pharma Limited (NSE: AUROPHARMA) — Multi-Engine Scale, Eugia Compliance Drag & Dual-Action No-FOMO Plan
subtitle: Price-blind ten-year operational forensics, Reverse DCF valuation, Stage 2 support mapping, and actionable rules at ₹1,807.20
primer: Aurobindo Pharma just posted record Q2 FY27 sales of ₹10,263 Cr with 21.0% EBITDA margins and USD 189 million in net cash. Kakinada Penicillin-G now runs at 10,000 tonnes a year and already earns positive operating cash without PLI aid. However, Eugia Unit I drew an August 2026 FDA Warning Letter, and return on capital sits at just 12.9%. At ₹1,807.20, new money must wait for support at ₹1,680.29–₹1,765.44, while existing shares hold with a hard ₹1,570.64 stop.
holding_rationale: The position stays small at 0.63% of capital. Stage 2 trend remains intact. Price holds above the rising 50-day average of ₹1,686.07. It also clears the 30-week average of ₹1,591.79. Guard the lot with a daily closing stop at ₹1,570.64. Plan to trim 5 shares at ₹2,350.00 if Eugia FDA warnings stay open.

holding_alerts.trigger: Daily NSE close at or below ₹1,570.64, below the 30-week average and support pivot
holding_alerts.instruction: Sell all 15 shares on any closing breach of ₹1,570.64 to cap losses at -13.09%.

holding_alerts.trigger: Rally to ₹2,350.00+ while Eugia Unit I or Unit III FDA Warning Letters remain unresolved
holding_alerts.instruction: Trim 5 shares into strength and trail the remaining 10 shares beneath the 10-week EMA.

holding_alerts.trigger: USFDA Import Alert at Eugia Unit I or III, or quarterly EBITDA margin below 17.5%
holding_alerts.instruction: Sell all 15 shares at the next open without waiting for the price stop.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Idle cash held in Zerodha treasury (holding_shares_to_sell = 0 today; new cash awaits pullback support)

destinations.recommendation: Keep 100% of planned AUROPHARMA buying power in cash until ₹1,680.29–₹1,765.44 hits.
destinations.rationale: At ₹1,807.20, reward-to-risk is only 1.07:1. Cash earns safety until a pullback restores 1.51:1 to 2.21:1 odds.
destinations.entry_condition: Buy in stages inside ₹1,680.29–₹1,765.44 on quiet volume holding above ₹1,680.

destinations.recommendation: Keep TANFACIND on hold rather than rotating fresh cash today.
destinations.rationale: Despite 2.80:1 long-term asymmetry, TANFACIND carries a momentum wait cap and falling trailing profits.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only when quarterly earnings recover above ₹3,294.17 support.

destinations.recommendation: Track outside peer LUPIN on strong 29.9% ROCE, but wait for confirmed Stage 2 recovery.
destinations.rationale: LUPIN trades at 16.4x P/E with high margins, yet daily ledger bars classify it in Stage 4 Markdown beneath ₹2,036.57 50-DMA and ₹2,237.19 200-DMA while snapshots show early Stage 1 base-building under ₹2,217.23.
destinations.entry_condition: Enter only after price reclaims Stage 2 above its rising 30-week average (~₹2,217+) on expanding volume.
